---
title: natbib document with nocite and no citation
format: pdf
cite-method: natbib
bibliography: natbib.bib
biblio-style: plainnat
nocite: |
  @*
_quarto:
  tests:
    pdf:
      noErrors: []
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: 'generating bibliography'
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
        - ['The TeXbook']
        - []
---

This document cites nothing in its text but sets `nocite: "@*"`, which writes `\nocite{*}`, so the `.aux` file still has a `\citation{*}` entry and BibTeX must run to list every reference.
